posts.zh:
dsh-deepseek-vision 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。复用 DeepSeek 网页端识图模式给纯文本模型补上看图能力：deepseek_vision 工具调用本地 deepseek-vision-cli 浏览器自动化（手动登录助手、自动开启深度思考、用后自动关窗），把图片描述以文字返回给模型。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6af2935f4137afe0fd06.html
posts.en:
dsh-deepseek-vision is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Reuses DeepSeek web's built-in vision mode for text-only models: the deepseek_vision tool drives the local deepseek-vision-cli browser automation (manual login helper, deep-think enabled, auto-closes browser) and returns image descriptions as text.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6af2935f4137afe0fd06.html
